metadata.title: Monochrome Back Portrait with Chicano Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy black and white rear-view portrait of a man with cornrow braids and prominent Chicano-style script tattoos across the upper back.
triggerTerms: rear view portrait with back tattoo
excludeWhen: clean, high-key studio lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, waist-up rear view of a muscular man. The focus is on the intricate cornrow braids leading to a small bun at the nape and a large, arched black-letter script tattoo spanning the shoulder blades. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting the skin's texture and the silver grain of the film.
coreVisualRelationships: The arch of the tattoo follows the natural curve of the trapezius muscles.
The vertical lines of the braids contrast with the horizontal span of the lettering.
The soft, blurred background isolates the sharp detail of the skin and ink.
coreInvariants: Monochrome grayscale palette with heavy film grain.
Symmetrical composition centered on the spine.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, complex lettering of the tattoo across the upper back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top with the braids, follows the neck down to the tattoo, then descends along the spine.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily in the upper corners with a soft, out-of-focus gray gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair, tattoo ink, and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights on the shoulders and hair ridges.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; value range is wide with crushed blacks and blown-out highlights in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline following the shoulder line
Heavy use of flourishes and swashes
High-contrast strokes with sharp, thorn-like serifs
Interlocking characters with internal decorative filigree
characterSpecificRedesigns: Internal negative space filled with diamond-shaped dots
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script style with smaller, secondary cursive script on the neck.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the cultural and stylistic origin of the lettering.
Provides the necessary gothic weight and complexity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black and white rear-view photo of a man with cornrow braids, focusing on the texture of the skin and hair under directional light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom-drawn, arched Chicano-style script tattoo across the shoulder blades, ensuring the ink appears aged and integrated into the skin texture.

verificationChecks: Does the tattoo follow the anatomical curve of the shoulders?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Are the braids sharp and detailed?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the tattoo looks like ink in skin, not a sticker.
Verify the grain doesn't obscure the braid detail.
Ensure the arch of the text is symmetrical.
Confirm the background remains softly blurred.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rear-view monochrome portrait + [Subject Detail: Braided Hair] + [Graphic Element: Arched Chicano Tattoo] + [Style: Grainy Film Noir]
